summary.zh-CN: 逐项检查 robots、noindex、canonical、sitemap、语言和内链，分清本地与线上。
summary.en: Check crawl directives, canonical, sitemap, language and links while separating local and live evidence.

inputs.zh-CN: URL、公开索引意图、HTML/响应头/robots/sitemap/内链
inputs.en: URL, indexing intent, HTML, headers, robots, sitemap and links

outputs.zh-CN: 七项证据审计；阻塞、未知与修复建议
outputs.en: Seven evidence checks, blockers, unknowns and proposed fixes

safety.zh-CN: 默认只读与本地产物；不自动修改生产、提交索引或外发。
safety.en: Read-only analysis and local artifacts by default; no automatic production changes, indexing submission or outreach.

prompt.zh-CN: 请使用 $seo-publish-audit，仅分析我提供或已授权读取的资料。先检查必要输入，未知数据保留未知，按 Skill 模板交付并列出验收结果；不要自动发布。
prompt.en: Use $seo-publish-audit to analyze only supplied or authorized materials. Check required inputs, preserve unknowns, deliver the skill template and acceptance results, and do not publish automatically.
